name: Replicate
description: Run models on Replicate and read what the run produced.
long_description:
Replicate's hosted server. It searches models, starts a prediction and reads the result, which is how a chat generates an image or transcribes a file without Gantry shipping a model.

A prediction costs money on your Replicate account, so starting one is confirmed every time.

auth.instructions: Sign in to Replicate in your browser; the server registers Gantry on the spot.

risk.notes: Runs models on your Replicate account, which is billed per run.
